# theme (contract v11)

Every themeable value. Shared values (type scale, line heights, spacing, motion, layout measures, stacking layers) are set once. Each theme sets color roles for light and dark (page; surface, raised, sunken, and subtle surfaces; scripture bed; border; primary, secondary, and muted text; action and text on action for anything clickable; accent and text on accent for non-clickable emphasis; note marker; selection; correct; incorrect; edge tabs for theologian and notes; chat surface and user bubble; dim overlay; four highlight colors {yellow, green, blue, rose}; nine Bible category group colors {law, othist, wisdom, major, minor, gospel, paul, general, apoc}), style (display, body, reading, and label fonts; corner radius scale including chip, control, card, frame; border weight and style; shadows including card, frame, overlay; backdrop; surface and border filters; texture; illustration set), and optional per-mode shadows and ornaments. Derived colors are generated. fontSources are fetched at build time; fontImports are what the site loads. Contrast rules cover text and clickable controls (WCAG AA); borders and accents are decorative and not contrast-checked; translucent colors are measured as seen over the page. A theme may set a native mode used until the learner chooses light or dark. Shared fonts (serif, sans, mono) are defined once; themes choose among them by reference, so a theme cannot introduce another font. Ornaments are up to six decorative colors per mode that let a theme be polychrome or near-monochrome. Shelf roles (wood and iron) color the Shelf home bookshelf: planks, support blocks and bookends; they are decorative and not contrast-checked. The radius scale also includes bar (progress bars) and marker (tooltips, step markers).
